# Urological procedures postop antimicrobial prophylaxis:

*Postoperative antimicrobial administration for preventing SSI is not

necessary for most procedures.

*Prophylactic antibiotics should be discontinued within 24 hours.

[<Click here> AUA Surgery Abx Prophylaxis Guidelines](orz-gtx-abx-aua-surgery-prophyl)

# INPATIENT Postop IV medications:

Preferred:

[Cefazolin Weight Based Dosing q8h x2 doses postop](orzid2-gmenu-surg-cefazolin-wt-based-postop-doses-x2)

Alternative for beta lactam allergy:

[Click here Beta-lactam allergy assessment](orz-gtx-abx-beta-lactam-reaction-pdf)

[Vancomycin 15mg/kg Dosing q12h x1 dose postop](orzid2-gmenu-surg-vancomycin-post-op-specific-dosing)

# INPATIENT Postop Oral Medications:

[Cephalexin 500mg PO q6h X1 day postop urology \($\) R](psjzid2-cephalexin-500mg-po-q6h-x1day-postop-urology)

< OR >

[Sulfa/Trimeth DS 1 tablet po q12h X1 day postop urology procedure \($\) R,DI](psjzid2-trimeth-sulfa-ds-q12h-x1day-postop-urology)

< OR >

[Nitrofurantoin SA 1 capsule q12h X1 day postop urology procedure \($\) R,O](psjzid2-nitrofurantoin-sa-1-q12h-x1day-post-op-urology)

# OUTPATIENT POSTOP PRESCRIPTION ORDERS:

Prophylaxis may be recommended in limited cases due to the severity of

complications of postoperative infection (e.g., an infected device that is

not easily removable).

[Cephalexin 500mg PO qid X5 days postop urology procedure \($\) R](psozid2-cephalexin-500mg-po-qid-x5days-postop-urology)

< OR >

[Sulfa/Trimeth 1 DS tablet PO q12h X5 days postop urology procedure \($\) R,DI](psozid2-trimeth-sulfa-1-ds-po-bid-x5days-postop-urology)

< OR >

[Nitrofurantoin SA 1 capsule q12h X5 days postop urology procedure \($\) R,O](psozid2-nitrofurantoin-sa-1-bid-x5days-postop-urology)

References

MVAHCS Urology Section (July 2023)

Lightner DJ, et al. Best Practice Statement on Urologic Procedures

and Antimicrobial Prophylaxis, J Urol (2020) 203:351

Bratzler DW, et al.  Clinical practice guidelines for antimicrobial prophy

in surgery, Am J Health-Syst Pharm. 2013 Vol 70 page 195-283
